Description: Advanced aerial observer. Maintains the unit cap set by the Overlord. Can use Spawn Changeling and Contaminate. The Overseer is extremely useful for scouting and detecting enemy units/positions. It moves faster than the Overlord and also receives the benefit of the Pneumatized Carapace upgrade. In return, it loses the Overlord's ability to transport units and Generate Creep.

Competitive Usage.General: It is a generally a good idea to include Overseers in a mid-end game army to detect any stealth units. The Overseer is extremely useful for scouting and detecting enemy units/positions. It moves faster than the Overlord and also receives the benefit of the Pneumatized Carapace upgrade. In return, it loses the Overlord's ability to transport units and Generate Creep.
Competitive Usage.Vs. Protoss: Overseers are essential for detecting Dark Templar and other cloaked units. They provide crucial vision and detection capabilities against Protoss stealth units.
Competitive Usage.Vs. Terran: Overseers are important for detecting Banshees and other cloaked Terran units. They provide aerial scouting and detection against Terran stealth tactics.
Competitive Usage.Vs. Zerg: Overseers are useful for detecting burrowed units like Lurkers and Infestors. They also provide aerial vision and can spawn Changelings to scout enemy positions.
